# THIS = a state, in the late sweep: a treated part (te_dg_lx_ft, te_dg_lx_mt) into the step's deaths by cause at its
# biological rate age local_var:te_dg_lx_rb (demographics_model.lx_causes_at): its people x each cause's base rate
# there, the multipliers left for te_demog_lx_cause_deaths; work's women and men apart, and infection at the adults'
# ages (te_dg_lx_ce_infa) apart from the rest.
te_demog_lx_causes_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_rb < 75 }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_rb < 35 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_rb < 15 }
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_rb < 5 }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_rb < 1 }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_ce_inf add = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_ft multiply = 19000 add = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_mt multiply = 21000 } } }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_ce_ext add = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_ft multiply = 60 add = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_mt multiply = 70 } } }
					}
					else = {
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_ce_inf add = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_ft multiply = 4200 add = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_mt multiply = 4300 } } }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_ce_ext add = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_ft multiply = 60 add = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_mt multiply = 70 } } }
					}
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_rb < 10 }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_ce_inf add = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_ft multiply = 1000 add = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_mt multiply = 1000 } } }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_ce_ext add = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_ft multiply = 40 add = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_mt multiply = 50 } } }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_ce_chr add = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_ft multiply = 60 add = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_mt multiply = 78 } } }
					}
					else = {
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_ce_inf add = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_ft multiply = 550 add = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_mt multiply = 550 } } }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_ce_ext add = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_ft multiply = 40 add = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_mt multiply = 50 } } }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_ce_chr add = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_ft multiply = 60 add = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_mt multiply = 78 } } }
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_rb < 25 }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_rb < 20 }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_ce_infa add = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_ft multiply = 750 add = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_mt multiply = 750 } } }
						change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_ce_ext add = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_ft multiply = 60 add = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_mt multiply = 180 } } }

# THIS = a state, in the late sweep: at an age local_var:te_dg_lx_fa, the unplanned schedule te_dg_lx_asfr (the body's),
# fecundity te_dg_lx_fec (§3.2) and the planned schedule as intended te_dg_lx_int (today's shape over the fecundity it
# carries; demographics_model.asfr_unplanned, fecundity, intended), each per single year, per 100,000.
te_demog_lx_fert_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_fa < 35 }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_fa < 25 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_fa < 20 }
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_fa < 15 }
					set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_asfr value = 0 }
					set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_fec value = 1 }
					set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_int value = 0 }
				}
				else = {
					set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_asfr value = 1200 }
					set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_fec value = 1 }
					set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_int value = 1200 }
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_asfr value = 4400 }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_fec value = 1 }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_int value = 4400 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_fa < 30 }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_asfr value = 5000 }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_fec value = 1 }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_int value = 5000 }
			}
			else = {
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_asfr value = 4200 }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_fec value = 1 }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_int value = 4200 }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_fa < 45 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_fa < 40 }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_asfr value = 3000 }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_fec value = 0.9 }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_int value = 3333.33333 }
			}
			else = {
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_asfr value = 1700 }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_fec value = 0.7 }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_int value = 2428.57143 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_fa < 50 }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_asfr value = 500 }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_fec value = 0.35 }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_int value = 1428.57143 }
			}
			else = {
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_asfr value = 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_fec value = 0 }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_int value = 0 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# THIS = a state: capacity (x call 3's input te_dg_wk_capm, at most 1) and health need at a treated part's biological
# age local_var:te_dg_lx_ab (demographics_model.capacity_at, band_value), into te_dg_cap and te_dg_needw.
te_demog_lx_bio_band_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_ab < 65 }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_ab < 45 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_ab < 15 }
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_ab < 5 }
					set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_cap value = { value = 1 multiply = local_var:te_dg_wk_capm max = 1 } }
					set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_needw value = 1 }
				}
				else = {
					set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_cap value = { value = 1 multiply = local_var:te_dg_wk_capm max = 1 } }
					set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_needw value = 0.5 }
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_cap value = { value = 1 multiply = local_var:te_dg_wk_capm max = 1 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_needw value = 0.8 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_ab < 60 }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_cap value = { value = 1 multiply = local_var:te_dg_wk_capm max = 1 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_needw value = 1.4 }
			}
			else = {
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_cap value = { value = 1 multiply = local_var:te_dg_wk_capm max = 1 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_needw value = 1.4 }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_ab < 80 }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_ab < 75 }
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_ab < 70 }
					set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_cap value = { value = 0.95 multiply = local_var:te_dg_wk_capm max = 1 } }
					set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_needw value = 2.4 }
				}
				else = {
					set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_cap value = { value = 0.85 multiply = local_var:te_dg_wk_capm max = 1 } }
					set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_needw value = 2.4 }
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_cap value = { value = 0.7 multiply = local_var:te_dg_wk_capm max = 1 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_needw value = 3.4 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_ab < 85 }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_cap value = { value = 0.5 multiply = local_var:te_dg_wk_capm max = 1 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_needw value = 3.4 }
			}
			else = {
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_cap value = { value = 0.2 multiply = local_var:te_dg_wk_capm max = 1 } }
				set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_needw value = 4.5 }
			}
		}
	}
}

					else = {
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_uf25 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_guf }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_um25 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gum }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_tf25 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gtf }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_tm25 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gtm }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_tqf25 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gtqf }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_tqm25 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gtqm }
					}
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:te_dg_g <= 26 }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_uf26 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_guf }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_um26 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gum }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_tf26 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gtf }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_tm26 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gtm }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_tqf26 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gtqf }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_tqm26 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gtqm }
					}
					else = {
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_uf27 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_guf }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_um27 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gum }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_tf27 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gtf }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_tm27 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gtm }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_tqf27 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gtqf }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_tqm27 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gtqm }
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:te_dg_g <= 29 }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:te_dg_g <= 28 }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_uf28 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_guf }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_um28 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gum }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_tf28 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gtf }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_tm28 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gtm }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_tqf28 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gtqf }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_tqm28 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gtqm }
					}
					else = {
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_uf29 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_guf }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_um29 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gum }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_tf29 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gtf }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_tm29 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gtm }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_tqf29 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gtqf }
						set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_tqm29 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gtqm }
					}
				}
				else = {
					set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_uf30 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_guf }
					set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_um30 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gum }
					set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_tf30 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gtf }
					set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_tm30 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gtm }
					set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_tqf30 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gtqf }
					set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lxa_tqm30 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_gtqm }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_guf value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_gum value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_gtf value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_gtm value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_gtqf value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_gtqm value = 0 }
	# uploaded minds (2026-10-19): the treated's infection-and-chronic sums, while this step books uploads
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_dg_um_sums > 0 } te_demog_um_group_flush = yes }
}

# THIS = a state after the late sweep (te_demog_lx_finish): the three period life tables (demographics_model.lx_tables)
# from the sums te_demog_lx_group_flush kept. The untreated's old-age threshold is te_dg_old_age_c (Linked to Common
# Longevity follows it) and its Living to 100 te_dg_lx_l100u; the treated's Living to 100 te_dg_lx_l100t; the blend
# is the state's own and replaces the step's life expectancy, e65 and old-age threshold (te_dg_e0, te_dg_old_age:
# Linked to Average Longevity follows it) with its Living to 100 te_dg_lx_l100. Then rho, the adults' treated deaths

	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_rtp add = local_var:te_dg_lxa_tm30 }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_ruq add = { value = local_var:te_dg_lxa_um30 multiply = local_var:te_dg_lxu_qm30 } }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_rup add = local_var:te_dg_lxa_um30 }
	set_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_rho value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:te_dg_lx_rtp > 0
			local_var:te_dg_lx_rup > 0
			local_var:te_dg_lx_ruq > 0
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_rho value = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_rtq divide = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_rtp min = 0.00001 } divide = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_ruq divide = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_rup min = 0.00001 } min = 0.00001 } } }
	}
}

# THIS = a state (demographics_model.lx_targets): eligibility's target te_dg_lx_target, access people-weighted over
# the walk's wealth bands (te_dg_gn<k>), each band the larger of the public route (te_dg_lx_pub) and the market
# route, a ramp from 0 at the threshold less te_demog_k_lx_market_ramp to 1 as far above it. No carrier or Human
# Purity: none; no bands: the public route alone.
te_demog_lx_access = {
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_target value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_pub value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			te_demog_lx_carrier_on > 0
			te_demog_lx_banned = 0
		}
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_pub value = te_demog_lx_public }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_lo value = { value = te_demog_lx_threshold subtract = te_demog_k_lx_market_ramp } }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_n value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_na value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_gn1 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_n add = var:te_dg_gn1 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_na add = { value = 1 subtract = local_var:te_dg_lx_lo divide = 20 min = 0 max = 1 min = local_var:te_dg_lx_pub multiply = var:te_dg_gn1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_gn2 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_n add = var:te_dg_gn2 }

			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_n add = var:te_dg_gn38 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_na add = { value = 183 subtract = local_var:te_dg_lx_lo divide = 20 min = 0 max = 1 min = local_var:te_dg_lx_pub multiply = var:te_dg_gn38 } }

		}
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_target value = local_var:te_dg_lx_pub }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_n > 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_target value = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_na divide = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_n min = 0.00001 } } }
		}
	}
}

# THIS = a state after the late sweep (demographics_model.lx_wealth_slope; late-game §4.3, call 14): each wealth band's
# death multiplier 1 - its treated share x (1 - rho), its treated share its access scaled so their mean is the ring's
# (te_dg_lx_sbar over eligibility's target), and the people-weighted slope of that multiplier over the state's mean
# against wealth: te_dg_lx_slope (per wealth level, on the census's rate) and te_dg_lx_mbar (the mean). Needs
# te_demog_lx_access's locals (te_dg_lx_lo, te_dg_lx_pub, te_dg_lx_target) and the step's te_dg_lx_rho, te_dg_lx_sbar.

	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_sn value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_sw value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_sww value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_sm value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_swm value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_tau_k value = { value = var:te_dg_lx_sbar divide = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_target min = 0.00001 } } }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_rho1 value = { value = 1 subtract = var:te_dg_lx_rho } }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_target > 0 }

		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_mm value = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_sm divide = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_sn min = 0.00001 } } }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_vw value = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_sww divide = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_sn min = 0.00001 } subtract = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_mw multiply = local_var:te_dg_lx_mw } } }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_mbar value = local_var:te_dg_lx_mm }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_lx_vw > 0.01 }
			set_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_slope value = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_swm divide = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_sn min = 0.00001 } subtract = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_mw multiply = local_var:te_dg_lx_mm } divide = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_vw min = 0.00001 } divide = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_mm min = 0.00001 } } }
		}
	}
}

# THIS = a state, in its seed once ageing is slowed (te_demog_lx_seed; demographics_model.lx_seed): every band with an
# adult (its oldest cohort te_demog_k_lx_join_age or more) at s = local_var:te_dg_lx_e and the steady state of the
# ageing rate local_var:te_dg_lx_rr, d = (1 - r) x (the band's middle cohort's age - te_demog_k_lx_join_age).
te_demog_lx_seed_bands = {
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_old value = { value = local_var:te_dg_open subtract = 0 add = 300 modulo = 300 } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:te_dg_lx_old >= te_demog_k_lx_join_age
			local_var:te_dg_lx_e > 0
		}
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_s0 value = local_var:te_dg_lx_e }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_d0 value = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_old subtract = 2 subtract = te_demog_k_lx_join_age min = 0 multiply = { value = 1 subtract = local_var:te_dg_lx_rr } } }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_lx_old value = { value = local_var:te_dg_open subtract = 5 add = 300 modulo = 300 } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			local_var:te_dg_lx_old >= te_demog_k_lx_join_age

# THIS = a state, after a late step's scale (te_demog_step_finish): the biological pyramid's bands te_dg_bb<f|m><band>,
# the calendar ones with the moves at the new scale; its people past each row's start past 85, te_dg_bo<f|m><i>, the
# calendar ones (te_dg_o<f|m><i>) with theirs, where anyone is, and the rows it shows (te_dg_bpyr_top, te_dg_bpx<f|m><i>;
# issue #1075); and the pyramid's scale over both views.

	set_variable = { name = te_dg_bbf0 value = { value = local_var:te_dg_lx_mvf0 multiply = local_var:te_dg_new_scale add = var:te_dg_bf0 min = 0 } }

		remove_variable = te_dg_bbf12
		remove_variable = te_dg_bbm12
		remove_variable = te_dg_bbf13
		remove_variable = te_dg_bbm13
		remove_variable = te_dg_bbf14
		remove_variable = te_dg_bbm14
		remove_variable = te_dg_bbf15
		remove_variable = te_dg_bbm15
		remove_variable = te_dg_bbf16
		remove_variable = te_dg_bbm16
		remove_variable = te_dg_bbf17
		remove_variable = te_dg_bbm17
	}
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_dg_bof1 } remove_variable = te_dg_bof1 remove_variable = te_dg_bom1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_dg_bof2 } remove_variable = te_dg_bof2 remove_variable = te_dg_bom2 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_dg_bof3 } remove_variable = te_dg_bof3 remove_variable = te_dg_bom3 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_dg_bof4 } remove_variable = te_dg_bof4 remove_variable = te_dg_bom4 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_dg_bof5 } remove_variable = te_dg_bof5 remove_variable = te_dg_bom5 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = te_dg_bof6 } remove_variable = te_dg_bof6 remove_variable = te_dg_bom6 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_bpyr_top }
		remove_variable = te_dg_bpyr_top
		remove_variable = te_dg_bpxf0
		remove_variable = te_dg_bpxm0
		remove_variable = te_dg_bpxf1
		remove_variable = te_dg_bpxm1
		remove_variable = te_dg_bpxf2
		remove_variable = te_dg_bpxm2
		remove_variable = te_dg_bpxf3
		remove_variable = te_dg_bpxm3
		remove_variable = te_dg_bpxf4
		remove_variable = te_dg_bpxm4
		remove_variable = te_dg_bpxf5
		remove_variable = te_dg_bpxm5
		remove_variable = te_dg_bpxf6
		remove_variable = te_dg_bpxm6
	}
}

# THIS = ROOT = a country, in te_demog_country_census: whether any of its states has a biological pyramid
# (te_dg_c_lx_bion; with none the country keeps none and the loop adds nothing), and its sums at 0 (te_dg_c_lx_bbn
# counts the states that have one).
te_demog_lx_country_bio_init = {
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_lx_bbn value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_lx_bion value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { any_scope_state = { has_variable = te_dg_bbf0 } }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_lx_bion value = 1 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf0 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm0 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf1 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm1 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf2 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm2 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf3 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm3 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf4 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm4 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf5 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm5 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf6 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm6 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf7 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm7 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf8 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm8 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf9 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm9 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf10 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm10 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf11 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm11 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf12 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm12 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf13 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm13 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf14 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm14 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf15 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm15 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf16 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm16 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf17 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm17 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bof1 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bom1 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bof2 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bom2 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bof3 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bom3 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bof4 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bom4 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bof5 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bom5 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bof6 value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bom6 value = 0 }
	}

# THIS = a census state in the country's loop: its biological bands and rows past 85, or its calendar ones where it
# has none.
te_demog_lx_country_bio_add = {
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_dg_c_lx_bion > 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_bbf0 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_lx_bbn add = 1 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf0 add = var:te_dg_bbf0 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm0 add = var:te_dg_bbm0 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf1 add = var:te_dg_bbf1 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm1 add = var:te_dg_bbm1 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf2 add = var:te_dg_bbf2 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm2 add = var:te_dg_bbm2 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf3 add = var:te_dg_bbf3 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm3 add = var:te_dg_bbm3 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf4 add = var:te_dg_bbf4 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm4 add = var:te_dg_bbm4 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf5 add = var:te_dg_bbf5 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm5 add = var:te_dg_bbm5 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf6 add = var:te_dg_bbf6 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm6 add = var:te_dg_bbm6 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf7 add = var:te_dg_bbf7 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm7 add = var:te_dg_bbm7 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf8 add = var:te_dg_bbf8 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm8 add = var:te_dg_bbm8 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf9 add = var:te_dg_bbf9 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm9 add = var:te_dg_bbm9 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf10 add = var:te_dg_bbf10 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm10 add = var:te_dg_bbm10 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf11 add = var:te_dg_bbf11 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm11 add = var:te_dg_bbm11 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf12 add = var:te_dg_bbf12 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm12 add = var:te_dg_bbm12 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf13 add = var:te_dg_bbf13 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm13 add = var:te_dg_bbm13 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf14 add = var:te_dg_bbf14 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm14 add = var:te_dg_bbm14 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf15 add = var:te_dg_bbf15 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm15 add = var:te_dg_bbm15 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf16 add = var:te_dg_bbf16 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm16 add = var:te_dg_bbm16 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf17 add = var:te_dg_bbf17 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm17 add = var:te_dg_bbm17 }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = te_dg_bof1 } change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bof1 add = var:te_dg_bof1 } change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bom1 add = var:te_dg_bom1 } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = te_dg_bof2 } change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bof2 add = var:te_dg_bof2 } change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bom2 add = var:te_dg_bom2 } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = te_dg_bof3 } change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bof3 add = var:te_dg_bof3 } change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bom3 add = var:te_dg_bom3 } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = te_dg_bof4 } change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bof4 add = var:te_dg_bof4 } change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bom4 add = var:te_dg_bom4 } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = te_dg_bof5 } change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bof5 add = var:te_dg_bof5 } change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bom5 add = var:te_dg_bom5 } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = te_dg_bof6 } change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bof6 add = var:te_dg_bof6 } change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bom6 add = var:te_dg_bom6 } }
		}
		else = {
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf0 add = var:te_dg_bf0 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm0 add = var:te_dg_bm0 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf1 add = var:te_dg_bf1 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm1 add = var:te_dg_bm1 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf2 add = var:te_dg_bf2 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm2 add = var:te_dg_bm2 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf3 add = var:te_dg_bf3 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm3 add = var:te_dg_bm3 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf4 add = var:te_dg_bf4 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm4 add = var:te_dg_bm4 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf5 add = var:te_dg_bf5 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm5 add = var:te_dg_bm5 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf6 add = var:te_dg_bf6 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm6 add = var:te_dg_bm6 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf7 add = var:te_dg_bf7 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm7 add = var:te_dg_bm7 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf8 add = var:te_dg_bf8 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm8 add = var:te_dg_bm8 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf9 add = var:te_dg_bf9 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm9 add = var:te_dg_bm9 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf10 add = var:te_dg_bf10 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm10 add = var:te_dg_bm10 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf11 add = var:te_dg_bf11 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm11 add = var:te_dg_bm11 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf12 add = var:te_dg_bf12 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm12 add = var:te_dg_bm12 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf13 add = var:te_dg_bf13 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm13 add = var:te_dg_bm13 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf14 add = var:te_dg_bf14 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm14 add = var:te_dg_bm14 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf15 add = var:te_dg_bf15 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm15 add = var:te_dg_bm15 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf16 add = var:te_dg_bf16 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm16 add = var:te_dg_bm16 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbf17 add = var:te_dg_bf17 }
			change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bbm17 add = var:te_dg_bm17 }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = te_dg_of1 } change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bof1 add = var:te_dg_of1 } change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bom1 add = var:te_dg_om1 } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = te_dg_of2 } change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bof2 add = var:te_dg_of2 } change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bom2 add = var:te_dg_om2 } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = te_dg_of3 } change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bof3 add = var:te_dg_of3 } change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bom3 add = var:te_dg_om3 } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = te_dg_of4 } change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bof4 add = var:te_dg_of4 } change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bom4 add = var:te_dg_om4 } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = te_dg_of5 } change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bof5 add = var:te_dg_of5 } change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bom5 add = var:te_dg_om5 } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = te_dg_of6 } change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bof6 add = var:te_dg_of6 } change_local_variable = { name = te_dg_c_bom6 add = var:te_dg_om6 } }
		}
	}
}

# THIS = ROOT = a country after its loop: the biological pyramid te_dg_cbb<f|m><band>, its rows past 85 (te_dg_cbo,
# te_dg_bpyr_top, te_dg_bpx) where any of its states has one (the scale over both views), else none.
te_demog_lx_country_bio_store = {
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:te_dg_c_lx_bbn > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbf0 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbf0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbm0 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbm0 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbf1 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbf1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbm1 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbm1 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbf2 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbf2 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbm2 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbm2 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbf3 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbf3 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbm3 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbm3 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbf4 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbf4 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbm4 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbm4 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbf5 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbf5 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbm5 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbm5 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbf6 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbf6 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbm6 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbm6 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbf7 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbf7 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbm7 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbm7 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbf8 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbf8 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbm8 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbm8 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbf9 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbf9 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbm9 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbm9 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbf10 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbf10 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbm10 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbm10 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbf11 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbf11 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbm11 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbm11 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbf12 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbf12 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbm12 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbm12 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbf13 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbf13 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbm13 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbm13 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbf14 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbf14 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbm14 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbm14 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbf15 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbf15 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbm15 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbm15 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbf16 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbf16 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbm16 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbm16 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbf17 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbf17 }
		set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbbm17 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bbm17 }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_c_bof1 > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbof1 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bof1 }
			set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbom1 value = { value = local_var:te_dg_c_bom1 min = 0 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_c_bom1 > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbof1 value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbom1 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bom1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cbof1 }
			remove_variable = te_dg_cbof1
			remove_variable = te_dg_cbom1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_c_bof2 > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbof2 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bof2 }
			set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbom2 value = { value = local_var:te_dg_c_bom2 min = 0 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_c_bom2 > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbof2 value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbom2 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bom2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cbof2 }
			remove_variable = te_dg_cbof2
			remove_variable = te_dg_cbom2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_c_bof3 > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbof3 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bof3 }
			set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbom3 value = { value = local_var:te_dg_c_bom3 min = 0 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_c_bom3 > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbof3 value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbom3 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bom3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cbof3 }
			remove_variable = te_dg_cbof3
			remove_variable = te_dg_cbom3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_c_bof4 > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbof4 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bof4 }
			set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbom4 value = { value = local_var:te_dg_c_bom4 min = 0 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:te_dg_c_bom4 > 0 }
			set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbof4 value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = te_dg_cbom4 value = local_var:te_dg_c_bom4 }
		}
		else_if = {
